focus.title: 欧盟对华电动汽车反补贴税终裁落地，出海车企需重构定价与供应链
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于2026年10月30日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查终裁，决定征收为期五年的最终反补贴税，税率因企业配合程度而异。中国车企面临出口成本上升与市场份额压力，需重新评估欧洲定价策略、本地化生产布局及供应链溯源合规。建议企业关注终裁文本中的承诺机制，评估价格承诺或本地化投资替代方案，并同步排查电池组件、关键矿物的原产地规则风险，避免叠加触发其他贸易救济措施。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会贸易救济公告 · 2026.10.30
focus.title_en: EU Imposes Final Countervailing Duties on Chinese EVs: Exporters Must Rethink Pricing and Supply Chains
focus.summary_en: The European Commission published its final countervailing duty determination on Chinese electric vehicles on 30 October 2026, imposing five-year duties at rates varying by company cooperation. Chinese automakers face higher export costs and market share pressure, requiring reassessment of European pricing, local production footprint and supply chain traceability compliance. Companies should examine the undertaking mechanism in the final text, evaluate price undertakings or local investment as alternatives, and screen battery components and critical minerals for rules-of-origin risks to avoid triggering additional trade remedies.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission trade remedies notice · 30 Oct 2026

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭明确跨境仲裁禁诉令边界，中企海外维权可援引
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期审结一起涉中资企业的国际工程合同纠纷，明确当外国法院诉讼构成对仲裁协议的违反且造成压迫性后果时，新加坡法院可颁发禁诉令。该案确立的“压迫性及无理缠讼”标准，为中企在“一带一路”项目中遭遇对方在第三国提起诉讼、意图规避仲裁时提供了可操作救济路径。建议中企在合同中明确约定仲裁地与仲裁规则，并在境外诉讼启动后及时向仲裁地法院申请禁诉令，同时保全证据、评估反诉策略。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判例综述 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Clarifies Anti-Suit Injunction Boundaries in Cross-Border Arbitration
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently ruled on an international engineering contract dispute involving a Chinese enterprise, confirming that Singapore courts may grant anti-suit injunctions where foreign proceedings breach an arbitration agreement and cause oppressive consequences. The "oppressive and vexatious" standard offers Chinese companies a practical remedy when counterparties initiate third-country litigation to circumvent arbitration in Belt and Road projects. Companies should specify arbitration seat and rules in contracts, promptly seek anti-suit relief in the seat court after foreign proceedings commence, preserve evidence and assess counterclaim strategies.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal case review · Oct 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规实施，涉外企业合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近日实施跨境数据流动管理新规，进一步细化个人信息与重要数据出境的安全评估、标准合同及认证路径，并扩大“白名单”场景适用范围。新规为区内涉外企业开展跨境研发、供应链协同和客户服务提供更明确的合规指引，同时强化数据分类分级与出境后监督。建议企业尽快梳理数据资产地图，区分重要数据与个人信息，优先适用标准合同或认证机制，并建立出境数据台账与年度审计制度，防范跨境传输违规风险。
policy.source: 来源：广东省及港澳相关主管部门联合发布 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Rules in Greater Bay Area Clarify Compliance Paths for Foreign-Related Firms
policy.summary_en: New cross-border data flow rules have taken effect in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, refining security assessment, standard contract and certification pathways for outbound personal information and important data, and expanding the scope of "whitelist" scenarios. The rules provide clearer compliance guidance for foreign-related enterprises engaged in cross-border R&D, supply chain coordination and customer service, while strengthening data classification and post-transfer supervision. Companies should map data assets, distinguish important data from personal information, prioritise standard contracts or certification, and maintain outbound data records and annual audits to mitigate transfer risks.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint release by Guangdong and Hong Kong/Macao authorities · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美对华投资限制新规扩围，中企应前置搭建合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟进一步扩大对华半导体、人工智能等敏感领域的投资限制，并强化对间接投资与基金架构的穿透审查。中企及美元基金在搭建跨境架构时，应前置评估受限行业清单、资金来源与最终受益人披露要求，避免因“视同投资”规则触发处罚。建议在投资协议中加入合规陈述与保证、分手费及监管变化条款，并同步准备替代融资方案；对已存续项目开展合规审计，必要时调整治理结构与信息隔离安排，以降低被动退出风险。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球·iGlobal Law 律师团队 · 2026.11.02
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Restrictions Require Proactive Compliance Firewalls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States is moving to further expand investment restrictions in sensitive sectors such as semiconductors and artificial intelligence, and to strengthen look-through review of indirect investments and fund structures. Chinese companies and USD funds should assess restricted-sector lists, funding sources and ultimate beneficiary disclosure requirements at the structuring stage to avoid penalties under "deemed investment" rules. We recommend incorporating compliance representations and warranties, break fees and regulatory change clauses into investment agreements, preparing alternative financing, and conducting compliance audits of existing projects—adjusting governance and information barriers where necessary to reduce forced-exit risk.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law legal team · 2 Nov 2026
